top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) rests on a quantitative, independently reproduced mechanism: a designed small molecule forms a ternary complex with a target and an E3 ligase, so the target is ubiquitinated and destroyed. This event-driven action is a new, generative capability. Approved cereblon-dependent glues show the principle works in patients, so the missing approved PROTAC limits the downstream record but does not make it premature. The citation can be worded around induced proximity with no drug named, and the omission of Ciulli and others should be stated as a consequence of the three-person limit, not a merit judgement. Buchwald and Hartwig is mature and cleanly attributed but conceptually closer to the 2010 palladium coupling prize, so it ranks second, and no award is ranked last because two mature, defensible proposals exist.
